methodology.notes: CUSTOM CASCADED VOICE AGENT (not a native audio-realtime model). Pipeline: Soniox STT (stt-rt-v5) -> Humains bCortex multi-state orchestrator (gemini-3.5-flash via Vertex AI, thinkingLevel=low; same-model AI-Studio fallback on transient Vertex 429s) -> OpenAI TTS (gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy'), with a turn-taking politeness adapter between the bench and bCortex (dead-air filler, liveness/ear watchdogs, 2-second collision-protection turn-taking, backchannel gate; barge-in disabled). REPRODUCIBILITY: this board was produced on our canonical deployed bCortex platform with NO patches, so it maps one-to-one to a fully runnable stock system. PROMPT DISCLOSURE: for the leakage audit we provide the FEW-SHOT EXAMPLES and DIRECT INSTRUCTIONS in full, verbatim; only platform-specific elements (the output/CoT schema and the prompt-generator scaffolding) are withheld as platform IP -- they are identical across our unrelated production domains and contain no airline or benchmark-derived content. TTS substitution: Soniox persona-equivalent voices in place of the held-out ElevenLabs voices (credits exhausted) -- expecting Sierra to re-run with held-out voices per the voice policy. Single trial, Pass^1 only. All 50 airline tasks at 'regular' speech complexity; no omissions. Note: audio_native_config.provider is recorded as 'humains' (custom cascade), outside the current tau2 provider enum -- to be handled per the custom-submission coordination path.
